minecraft:written_book_content.title: 002: Tumblestones
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Professor Sans
pages: "Throughout my travels in this new land, I have come across numerous ruins containing all sorts of treasures, from fossils of ancient pokemon, to precious metals and artifacts. However, one thing that immediately caught my eye were the tumblestones present. "

"The structure of these stones seemed to match those depicted in the ancient tales from the Hisui region, so I hypothesize that this may have been the same material used to make ancient pokeballs with."
"Through a few quick experiments, I’ve found that all 3 variants of the tumblestones react when exposed to certain metals. Namely iron, copper, and gold."
"I have also noticed that when heated to high temperatures with lava or magma, they absorb nutrients from the surrounding earth and expand over the course of a few days."
"Perhaps different materials combined with different tumblestones are able to imbue certain properties into the resulting pokeball."
